description: This source file implements a set of functions for an HTTP request object, providing accessors for request environment variables such as document root, path info, server name, server port, protocol, and software. It is part of an HTTP server implementation, likely providing CGI-related functionalities.

classes.name: HTTP_BMO_REQ_OBJECT
classes.description: Object representing an HTTP request, with methods for retrieving request-specific environment variables.

methods.name: char * HttpBmoReqRcpGetDocumentRoot(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hBmoReq)
methods.description: Returns the document root URI path for the request, typically a CGI environment variable.

methods.name: char * HttpBmoReqRcpGetPathInfo(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hBmoReq)
methods.description: Constructs and returns the path info part of the request URI, based on the request object data.

methods.name: char * HttpBmoReqRcpGetPathTranslated(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hBmoReq)
methods.description: Returns the physical path translation of the request URI.

methods.name: char * HttpBmoReqRcpGetRemoteUser(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hBmoReq)
methods.description: Returns the remote user, if available; otherwise null.

methods.name: char * HttpBmoReqRcpGetScriptName(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hBmoReq)
methods.description: Returns the script name associated with the request; in this case, null.

methods.name: char * HttpBmoReqRcpGetServerName(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hBmoReq)
methods.description: Retrieves the server name serving the request using the object's method.

methods.name: USHORT HttpBmoReqRcpGetServerPort(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hBmoReq)
methods.description: Retrieves the server port, usually from the object's method.

methods.name: char * HttpBmoReqRcpGetServerProtocol(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hBmoReq)
methods.description: Returns the server's protocol version string.

methods.name: char * HttpBmoReqRcpGetServerSoftware(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hBmoReq)
methods.description: Returns the server software name or product string.
